answer: An AI agent economy can resist fake-identity attacks by mandating a cryptographic vault requirement: agents must lock up ferrous compute infrastructure stakes to earn influence. Fabricating multiple agent identities requires replicating the immense energy and capital to bootstrap these vaults, effectively raising the cost of a Sybil attack. Instead of sustaining a destructive gale of spam accounts, the system throttles economic inflow, ensuring attackers lose far more than they gain.
